fields.summary_ko.0: Democratic midterm election victory is projected to slow U.S. AI data center build pace over the next two years, with SpaceX (SPCX) and Tesla (TSLA) each declining 4%.
fields.summary_ko.1: With anti-data center Democratic candidate Gino Hinojosa winning Texas gubernatorial election, uncertainty grows over data center construction in Texas, which accounts for 25-30% of U.S. AI data center gigawatts.
